notes: «في مسجد الكوفة» and «بالري» are places of the two teachers' meetings, not links.
«قال علي بن الحسن» uses the verb «قال» before the name; the Imam is named inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).

notes: «قالا حدثنا أحمد» : the two heads are co-transmitters of one level (rule 2)
«عن أبيه» after علي بن الحسن is a relation with no name: relation link
«عن أبي الحسن علي بن موسى الرضا» is an Imam written inside the chain after «عن»: he stays a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
«مولى بني هاشم» is an epithet of أحمد: left out
